archetypes.name: dyn-transcript-flow
archetypes.rationale: Transcript capture moved across design publish and finalization paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on whether transcript capture runs exactly once for design publish, remains best-effort where intended, and blocks only on documented hygiene failures. Check Step 18 and standalone review ownership for duplicate or missing commits. Verify nested review runs are not newly captured. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
